name: A Canine Consultation
source:
This short Visual Novel was made by Sun Paladin for the NaNoRenO 2023 Online Game Jam.

A short story that follows a late-night conversation between a bartender and a guest, who recently became a werewolf.

[Edited from [url=https://sun-paladin.itch.io/a-canine-consultation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部短篇视觉小说由Sun Paladin为NaNoRenO2023线上游戏创作活动制作。

故事讲述了一位酒保与一位刚变成狼人的客人之间的深夜交谈。

[编译自[url=https://sun-paladin.itch.io/a-canine-consultation]itch.io[/url]]
